notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!

Since part of the team is still working to release the new version of our matchmaking system the machine hasn’t stopped working and we are developing at full steam!

Part of the problem we are addressing is the code architecture: although the system works, the code wasn’t as scalable as we wanted it to be so we decided to spend some extra time fixing that. For the last few weeks, we have been removing old lines of code, refactoring some of the existing systems and making the development more agile for our programming team. 

This part of the job is almost invisible for the player but it is definitely worth it when it comes to scaling the project, update features and fix bugs. Spending time refactoring the architecture design - especially on big projects like Skara - will allow us to release new content more easily and quickly down on the road. 

As of today, this work is already showing nice results: after refactoring the data model and the login process we have dramatically reduced the loading times up to 80%. Creation of new characters is now more agile and efficient. The new skill modular system allows our designers to quickly prototype new Signs and combine them with other gameplay features to offer new ways to play the game. 

And that is precisely the main feature our design team is working on for the last 2-3 months: new characters, types of attacks, skills and game roles. In order to build a nice team fighting experience, we needed a wider variety of roles on the battlefield: pure healers and support characters, skills that can be combined with other characters to create powerful combos, even archers to strike on your enemies from distance! We can’t wait to show you all these new features. 

Meanwhile, our art team has been working on new cool stuff to make your survivors look cooler than ever! We have been also working on a new arena called Atash - if you have recently checked some of our streams on Twitch you will already know what are we talking about. 

See you on the battlefield.

notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/79c52deae19812d4cce3dce585094cfffa24245c.jpg

Welcome again, survivors!
 
We are ready to introduce the new Open Alpha Patch 0.8.1. We have been working on the performance of the game, as well as on adding some features, on character balancing and on some small improvements in all our maps.
 
The changes in this new build include:
 
New features:

    Video options menu
    Added texture streaming to improve loading performance

 
Character balancing:
Khärn: He needed a minor tweak to its basic attacks as the combination of multiple Khärns in LTS modes were too powerful. The damage reduced was compensated with an improvement of his Dash Attacks, that are now more effective. We are aware that this may affect duels more than we intended, will keep tracking match results and improve it over the coming builds.

    Basic Attacks damages reduced to 55/55/75 from 60/60/75
    First Basic Attack Impact changed to Medium from Hard
    Basic Dash Attack damage reduced to 50 from 55
    Specialized Dash Attack damage reduced to 55 from 60
    Solved a problem that made the Dash Attack to not connect with the enemy

 
Shinse: We detected a systematic usage of the sprint attack that wasn't giving much window to counterplay to other players. To strengthen her high risk high reward mechanics we want to move that focus back to her basic and specialized attacks. Most changes influence the penalization caused by impacts, allowing for a more combo focused attacks instead of getting in and out. Given her high skill cap we will be having a look at her performance.

    Sprint Attack Damage reduced to 65 from 75
    Basic Attack Damages adjusted to 50/50/60 from 55/45/60
    Specialized Attacks Impact improved to Medium from Light

 
Tamvaasa: We wanted the Vilkai Song to be more interesting making it harder to use in team based game modes and gives some reaction time when playing duels.

    Activation of Vilkai Song is now delayed by 66ms
    Time between cooldown consumption and actual effect activation has been increased giving more time for enemies to stop the skill before activation

 
Overall / Game Mode

    Added Specific Balance modifications for Game Mode Duel: Heals/Regenerations halved in terms of effectivity

 
Maps and textures improvements:

    “Gâo-Di - Temple of the Zem” map performance
    “Kilma - Blut at the Lava Coliseum” map performance
    “Jaarvi - The Circle of Axes” map performance
    “Coliseum Tutorial” map performance
    General textures

 
Fixes:

    Social: Improved the reception of friend requests
    Social: When joining in a match, sometimes you could see the conversation written in party chat, in the in-game one
    Social: Fixed the fact that you couldn’t invite a player which is already playing to a party
    Account: Fixed crash while loading session
    Account: Fixed problems with parties while changing the region
    Menu: Fixed a visual glitch where some character parts were not completely loaded
    Glyph system wasn’t being updated when changing bindings
    HUD skills when changing bindings of special skills to some key on numeric keyboard

 
See you on the battlefield,
 
The Skara Team

Welcome, survivors!

Get ready for the new features in the Open Alpha Update 0.8.0! We will present them to you in our Inaugural OA 0.8.0 Streaming in 30 minutes (at 5:30pm CET), but you always can enjoy our trailer here if you haven't been able to attend to it or look at them in more detail in the following paragraphs:

Lore event: Echoes from the Zem
It just started and it will follow nearly the same rewards structure as in the “Cataclysm” event that took place in February: there will be special rewards for the top 10 players in the event’s General Ranking and for the Top 1 in each Culture Ranking (you can check for the concrete rewards next to those Rankings in the in-game menu). New Map: Gâo-di - Temple of the Zem
After many iterations, we have come up with a new map setting that grants a really fun experience: set on the peak of a mountain, it has many bottlenecks, a completely new ambientation and its own special mechanics to redefine the way you play Skara. Words just stay short to what it really is… Enter the game and discover it!

Progression rewards
We are happy to introduce this feature that will allow you to earn skin rewards for free as you gain experience. notes.title: Skara Dev Update: Clearing the Beta launch pad
notes.notes:
It has been some weeks since our last update, but, as they say, no news is good news! Right?

It turns out there IS a lot of news to share as we work to get the game ready for a beta launch.

We currently are working on four fronts:


1) Improving gameplay


Improving overall combat feeling: We are shortening the attack delay and adding tactics to enter combat and counterattack.
Differentiating character-classes:
Shinse are now quicker and more lethal, but are also less armored than their fellow inhabitants of Skara.
Tamvassa are also quicker. They can be in the middle of a team battle formation and get in/out of combat easily.
Celea are more versatile and useful at keeping enemies at range, with an improved defense.
Khärn. These tank-like character have been completely reworked, but saying more would be giving it away...
New Defense types: Each character-class utilize a unique defense system that suit their combat style.
Better Dueling in Jaarvi: We looked at all the duels during our Alpha and used that data and your feedback to refactor the game mode.
Better Melee  in the Lava Coliseum: This is a completely new game mode, instead of all against all plus a boss fight, the Lava Coliseum has become a 3vs3 fight for your (single) life… more coming soon :)


2) Improving Skara’s visuals while optimizing the game (yes, this is actually possible!)

We are implementing the PBR (physically based rendering) logic to all our skins. This logic is used by most AAA studios in order to improve the visual aspect of their games.

We are also updating the textures, adding more details and improving the visual quality.

Here are some examples of the improvement:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/b9f1710abb635b5580f59fd10bf0c96931102713.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/25c1f374fce3b5bf3e8a1d444bf2fcf235efdfad.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/eea33e91d8e04d6c7347eb19071a0f414fa39774.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/cb6930efd5df81e8e54d02d1df44739a1c5c4c55.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/bca296b9ea90353998e96ca1fa17113f9b154ea6.png

We are applying the same logic to our maps while reducing their geometry by half. This will optimize the game without a noticeable visual downgrade!


3) Adding to Skara’s meta-game 

Yes, we know--one of the hardest parts of playing the alpha was a lack of social infrastructure to find friends and organize matches. The good news is Skara’s beta will have this infrastructure, including:

New social mechanic features (a friends list, menu and in-game chat, grouping with your friends before joining a game, and more...)
Smooth match flow, so you don’t have to wait long to get into the battle.
Error control on match flow, so the game doesn’t completely fall apart while organizing matches.
{*]This plays into the game combat as well. We have dramatically improved the Parry/Defense network system making it faster and more lifelike.


4) Here come the Khärn...

Finally, the Khärn will be making their comeback to Skara... We can’t wait to hear what you think!

For now, here is a tease of the improvements...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/0c95213e6fad4bdc12f0dd5740696c9c052ab380.jpg

See you on the Battlefield! 


Pablo and the Skara Team

notes.title: SKARA closes Alpha, prepares for Beta Release
notes.notes:
"What we have tasted, they have only wished. What we have seen, they have only dreamed… "-Account of Celean Conquest

Did you enjoy your taste test of SKARA?

The best is yet to come. 

We have gotten SO much out of the great feedback that we received from you over the last two months. We want to cap it off with a Dev Q&A session THIS FRIDAY on Twitch. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/05851c0c4bce5b54ea87b8ac1c19b688e1d284ed.jpg

Here’s what we have learned so far:

First, we learned that our vision IS going to work, that our brand of multiplayer close-combat is also what you have been waiting for. The more people playing SKARA, the more fun and competitive it is. We have the core of a great game in the making, but there is still a ways to go.  

Second, we now know what we need to do to streamline the game so that it is faster, more fun and more cruel. 

Anything that you found annoying about the UI or game progression (having to play through the tutorial, the graphic settings, etc.) will be fixed for Beta release. Also, expect more from the existing game, including a complete revision of how the free-for-all arena works. 

Third, we learned that the game really needs the final pieces we have planned (player-to-player communication, party chat, game forum integration, faction infrastructure) to be worth your and your friend’s time. 

Thanks again for providing all this feedback to us! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7046781/46b7a7a357aff38a47a87674eb187961d23c1165.jpg

Did we miss something? Let us know by getting in touch. Ask us a question here, on Twitter, Facebook or by email, and we will answer it at our September 30th Dev Q+A on Twitch. 

We will also post a video of this (in case you miss it) and as usual will be responding to any and ALL comments.

See you on the Battlefield (for a little longer)!
Pablo and the SKARA Team

notes.title: SKARA 0.5.6 LIVE STREAM AND CHANGELOG
notes.notes:
BUILD 0.5.6 CHANGELOG

Below find a summary of all the work we have done on Skara the last couple months. It will be a totally new experience once we have the new build running! 

Want to see it in action? Sign in to our Twitch channel on Thursday, January 28, at 6 CET, 5 GMT, 12 EST, 9 PST. 

http://www.twitch.tv/skarathebladeremains/

· Optimization: Characters & Environments will be optimized in this version. LOD’s for meshes and textures have been added to every skin and basic character. Coliseum and Zem have been compressed with batch files so they can be procedurally loaded to maximize performance.  

· New AI behaviour: Our beloved bots get an intelligence boost! Now they can use Talents and Skills as well react to Team Deathmatch situations (conquering towers or attacking the leading team). 

· New Zem look and Game Mode: We have finally implemented the final visual aspect for the Team Deathmatch arena, the Zem Moorlands, as well as completed the Domination Game Mode. Now, besides conquering towers, teams must be aware of the activated Pinnacle phases, in order to attack enemy pinnacles and so unlock conquered towers. 

· New character: Tamvaasa. The Northen warriors find their place in Skara with an awesome look and unique combat capabilities. Check the incredible Tamvaasa skills and invoke the powers of the fearsome vilkai, among many other things. The Tamvaasa put the Hack into Hack and Slash.

· New Gameplay feature: Talents. Choose two from four available Talents to enhance your combat style. Want to steal health from your foes with every hit? Try Inner Strike. Want to have a last chance when you are about to die? Trick Death is you talent. Increase the damage of your blows if you are about to die? Try To the Death. Want to recover Health when you are not fighting? Regeneration will do the job. 

· New UI look and functionalities: The final look of the UI will be available on the 0.5.6 as well. We have updated the news and content, character customization and a lot more. Pay attention as well to the nice Skara music we added to the menu navigation. 

· The store is open: The first iteration of the Skara store will be ready for the 0.5.6 build. Now you can purchase premium currency to buy cosmetic items for your characters. Only a few items will be available in this build, so check them out and be prepared for the next build, in which we’ll add a lot of new skins, fancy weapons and even custom mockeries and taunts!

· Re-factored combat system: Skara should now feel faster and more cruel. We re-defined how stamina and sprint bars work, we added attack cancellations and tweaked most of the values to balance the whole experience no matter which character you use. As usual, please send us feedback on the combat and if something feels unbalanced, let us know about it!

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.4 is LIVE
notes.notes:
It was another hot summer sweating next to the server fan for the Skara team, but nevertheless we were able to make another step of progress. Welcome to Build 0.5.4! 

Here’s a list of the new Features found in the 0.5.4 version: 

- A new playable tutorial (including a new environment: The Khilma dungeons).
- Power up items in the arenas (specifically health power ups and damage buffs).
- Try all three characters without leveling up! This is something a lot of our users requested and we were very happy to change. 
- Class skills are now attached to different buttons (Q&E on the keyboard, X and Y on Xbox controller)
- The Melee combat is faster now, the Hit stun is reduced. Also the free target mode has been modified to allow characters to dodge without losing focus on the target. 
- Rankings! Who will be the best? Find it in the War Log in the UI.
We also changed the Duel Game conditions to make it feel more like a Versus fighting game.  
- We’ve worked on the animations for all characters to make them more realistic and more spectacular. Characters should blend to sprint mode now and a lot of other features: Check them out! 
- New in-game HUD: Now you can check your enemy’s shield meter as well as the skills they’ve equipped. There’s also a new effort meter when sprinting. 
- Finally, we did a lot of Bug and crash fixing to make the game more stable. Please as usual send us feedback if something isn’t working by either writing in the forums, sending us an email, or filling out a bug report. 

Community development news. 

We know it has been difficult to find other players online, and we want to do everything we can to improve this. We can confirm there are a LOT of you out there! 

On of the issues we are facing is no budget for dedicated servers, which means players will not be able to find each other if they are not in the same general area.

This should get better once we get dedicated servers (hopefully soon!), but meanwhile the best way to find other players is to send a shout out on social media, like Twitter, Reddit, or in Steam. We have a million ideas for tackling this, but we are of course always happy to listen to you all. Remember: Sharing is caring. 

We have several more announcements coming soon, so stay tuned. And See you on the battlefield! 

Pablo and his ragtag group of indie pirate developers. ARRRRG!

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.3 is LIVE
notes.notes:
August is here and the SKARA team has been busier than ever improving the game. 

We have just released the 0.5.3 build. Instead of loading two builds, we decided to basically merge the content planned for the 0.5.2 and 0.5.3 versions into one, so we are jumping from 0.5.1 to 0.5.3 to avoid confusion. 

The result is a much bigger improvement in the game, we think. As usual, we look forward to your feedback. 

Here’s a list of the improvements to be found in the version 0.5.3

Bug fixing: these kind of things are normally invisible but you will notice a difference.

Thanks to popular demand, Keybindings and Invert Y camera options are now available both in-game and in the menu settings. 
New UI 3D scene. Now your character is always visible when navigating the menus. 

There are also new class skills for all characters:

Shinse gets Forest Wind to attack foes and escape from difficult, close-combat situations. 

Khärn are now able to attract enemies thanks to the new ability, Rage Vortex.

Celea can now turn their shielººd into flames and hurl it, hitting enemies from a range. It then returns, like a boomerang. 

We have released the first iteration for our matchmaking system. Now it is easier to join and leave matches, find people to play with and avoid crashing out. We know this has been the biggest hurdle to enjoying the game, and we are working hard to fix it. 

New HUD: Health bar and shield bar have different behaviour and graphics now. This feature is not finished though, and we’ll implement more changes in the 0.5.4 version. 

Durno and Tamvaasa silhouettes are now visible in the Character Selection menu... and will be coming soon!

XP and levels have been re-factored to make progression more balanced. This will wipe out all progress made thus far… sorry about that! 

Duels on Jaarvi are three kills based now, like some Versus games you may know… :)

Groth is now visible during the first phase of the Coliseum. Watch out at about the 5 minute mark of your match for him to be released. 


This Tuesday at 5pm UK time (6pm CET, 12pm EST, 9am PST), the Skara dev team will be livestreaming the new build on Twitch. Tune in to see the new features of the game in action. 

We also look forward to hearing from players who have tried the game and anyone who has an opinion or idea about its development. get in touch with us in the forums or on social. 
See you on the Battlefield! 

Pablo and the SKARA Team

notes.title: Skara Version 0.5.1 is LIVE
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the arrival of Skara 0.5.1! This is a first glimpse at the real deal. What came before was really more like a demo. A helpful demo, where we were able to create our combat system and try out tons of features, but a demo all the same. 

Now Skara feels like a game. 

Players create accounts, can choose characters and see progression. It’s a proper skeleton with some of the organs. Now we just need to add muscles and some skin--not to overdo the metaphor!

Highlight of New Features:

Class skills

Every character has their own special abilities,  making gameplay a lot more fun and tactical. 

It is now possible to personalise fighting styles by picking the character and their special abilities. 

Let us know if there are any balancing issues, and generally what you think of them. 

New Character: Khärn

The Khärn are more like a tank character than ever before: Slow and Strong. We definitely look forward to seeing how players use their abilities. We think they are pretty well balanced against the Celea and the Shinse, but this is something we aim to perfect.

Again, feedback will be useful! 

New Arena: Zem Moorlands
 
We brought in a dedicated Team Deathmatch arena: the Zem Moorlands, and, we think you will agree, the results are pretty spectacular.  

We’ve enjoyed trying the Team Deathmatch experience here in the studio, and we look forward to hearing what you think. 

If you find any bugs, inexplicably fall through the floor, or whatever else, let us know! 

NEXT STEPS: Match times, Streaming & Development Schedule

We are thinking about holding dedicated times to play Skara to help make it easier for players to find each other. Let us know if you want to create an official play time and we will do what we can. For now, if we are playing, expect to find us around  7pm CET time. 

Please feel free to stream your gameplay! This is the best way to spread the word. If you are interested in having your stream hosted on the official Skara Twitch channel, get in touch. 

Our development schedule continues apace. The last two characters are currently being modelled, we have new class skills in the works, and lots of plans for improvements to the UI and much more. 

Got a question? Want to know more? Get in touch! We are active on social media (

Skara on Twitter

Skara on Tumblr 

Skara on Facebook 

and will try and respond to emails sent to contact@skarathebladeremains.com

See you on the battlefield, 

Pablo

notes.title: The first version of Skara (0.4.0) and LAG
notes.notes:
After a long, long ride, somehow we managed to get Skara to a playable stage. What started as a side project born in the university is now close to being a proper game. But there’s still a lot of work to be done, and we want to rely on our community to get Skara to the next level and beyond. 

So, important things to notice about our Early Access launch version: It will have very limited features. Host a match or jump into a quick fight to try Skara’s newly designed combat system. Then help us to improve and balance it, we don’t want to move to the next phase until we deliver a competitive experience that fits the most demanding player. 

Then, every two weeks we’ll release new content for you to try out and provide us with feedback, propose new ideas and suggest ways to improve Skara. You can see the development Roadmap in our Store page, including the content for the upcoming two updates and our final goal: Skara’s full release.

We have been testing Skara internally, since we don’t have a budget for QA sessions, and we’ve already discovered some issues with slow connections and low-end computer specs. The game gets laggy and it’s almost impossible to play. We are working to fix that, but we need as much data as you can send us if you experience lag problems: your pc specs, your connection settings, if you are broadcasting Skara at the same time you play, etc. This is the only way we can take care of every specific case and move things to fix problems. The more of you reporting problems and laggy games, the faster we can fix the issue and improve the experience. 

What you should take away:  We do know that the game is at a very, very early stage, (especially everything involving menus, user interface and usability) but those things are easy to implement and we wanted to focus on the combat system--the most important element of gameplay. We also wanted to give the community (you!) every chance to collaborate with us to improve Skara through feedback and idea sharing. 

After all, if we release an almost completed game in Early Access, what’s left for you to develop with us?
